# Commit title format:
# type(scope): summary
#
# Examples:
# feat(ai): add provider settings
# fix(auth): handle expired reset tokens
# ci(workflow): enforce commit and PR templates
# docs(testing): document PR workflow
#
# Allowed types:
# build, chore, ci, docs, feat, fix, perf, refactor, revert, style, test
#
# Scope rules:
# - Optional.
# - Use lowercase letters, numbers, ".", "_", "-", or "/".
# - Prefer clear scopes such as ai, auth, frontend, docs, workflow, testing.
#
# Summary rules:
# - Keep it short and imperative.
# - Use one line.
# - Do not end with a period.
#
# Body template:
#
# Why:
# - TODO
#
# What:
# - TODO
#
# Tests:
# - TODO
